title: Unit Event — At The End of The Unraveled Thread — Episode8 I Just Want To Be Myself

meta.Event: At The End of The Unraveled Thread
meta.Episode: Episode8 — I Just Want To Be Myself
meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! is all set for their first TV appearance. However, the show's MC just happens to be the leader of the very group Shizuku used to be in, Cheerful * Days. As excited as she was about making their shoot a success, this surprise reunion has Shizuku...

rows.Line: TV Station - Studio

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Nice work, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right back at you, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I can't believe you were able to answer those questions with so much grace and dignity! The fact that they weren't in the script just reinforces my respect for you!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I feel the same way.
They weren't exactly nice questions either. The way you kept your cool was really impressive.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, Shizuku, you totally stole the show today!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You were able to say exactly how you felt, so I'm sure your fans will appreciate what you did. I'm definitely looking forward to when it airs!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm glad you're all saying that.
I somehow managed to answer her questions, but...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was sooo nervous...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I knew that I'd be asked about what happened when I was still in Cheerful * Days, but I wasn't expecting to be asked specifically about my persona.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: My heart raced the entire time, but this was also our very first time appearing on TV...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, I didn't want to give the wrong answer, but that only made me even more nervous...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Y-You're awfully talkative today...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I couldn't tell that you were so nervous. From my point of view, you seemed just fine.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But the way you kept your cool showed me that I need to do more!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Because I kept my cool...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I see. I'm glad to hear that...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In any case, we managed to get through it in one piece. And I think it went pretty well considering it was our first TV appearance.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I agree.
I'm looking forward to hearing what our fans think...
Nice work back there.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-Whoa! A-Arisa...?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hello...
Again, thank you for having us on today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Even though we're in different groups now, I had a lot of fun today...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
Oh...?
You call what just happened “fun”? Looks like someone finally grew up.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, what are you doing here all by yourself? Are you here just to say bye to us?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Or is there something you wanna say to Shizuku...? No, there's something you absolutely need to tell her.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Airi...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Are you talking about the time she...?)

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: No, there isn't.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You're kidding, right?!
You said all those horrible things about Shizuku back then and you totally badgered her today! You don't feel sorry at all?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A-Airi...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: I'll give you credit for not running away from those tough questions...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Also, don't forget that my goal all along was to make this show as entertaining as possible...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Remember what I said? I gave it everything I had. iHaz revolves around these sorts of interactions, so I was just doing my job.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: However, if I'm going to be honest, I may've sort of been looking forward to seeing Shizuku look like a lost puppy again.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's okay, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Wh-What is it...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Like I said during the shoot, I became overwhelmed with my own problems and wasn't able to help anyone else...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I feel awful about that and need to apologize for it. Also, there's something else...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: What? Now...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I know this may be too little too late...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However, I realize now that I was given a wonderful opportunity, which I squandered, and made several thoughtless comments in the process.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I really am. And you're all right. I... I should've asked the staff sooner if there was anything we could do about this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Being the lead also bothered me so much... I knew I wasn't the right person for the job when I was chosen...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I wish someone else were chosen instead of...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was chosen to be the lead. I was selected for the position that everyone dreams of becoming...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I didn't fully appreciate the scope of what I'd become. I selfishly thought that I wasn't cut out for it and that others were much more suited...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And I said out loud that I wished someone else were chosen instead... I realize now that I sullied my position by saying something so thoughtless.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Oh, just stop.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
You always do this.
You never think for yourself and just do as you're told.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: You were given a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity that the rest of us would do anything for, but you don't seem to care whatsoever about capitalizing on it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, Arisa, I now understand why you were so angry with me that time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm very sorry for what I did...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
So, you finally get it...
Took you long enough.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, it did...
I really was like a lost puppy back then...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But now, I know not to run away from my responsibilities or ask others to safeguard me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Of course, I still have a long way to go as an idol, and I still need to ask others for help from time to time like I did with Cheerful * Days.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: My fans... Those who prefer the old me, the current me or just me as I am... They mean the world to me...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
And when I hear their voices...
For some reason, I feel less afraid of being far from perfect.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Because I can now stand on stage with everyone here and just be myself.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I wish I'd made these realizations sooner when I was still with Cheerful * Days...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But the old me really didn't know what to do... She struggled so much that she couldn't fulfill her duties as the group's lead and ended up leaving... Like you said, I didn't “move on”...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I caused you all so much trouble.
So, I really need to tell everyone in Cheerful * Days that...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
What are you rambling on about?
I was just here to say bye to all of you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Arisa...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: I was convinced that you were all up a creek since you're trying to be idols without working with an agency, but it sounds like you're all having a lot of fun...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: And you seem to have friends who understand you much better.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: But don't get cocky just because your little solo show made a few headlines and led to your group being given a chance to appear on TV...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing how much you can all handle without the aid of others.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: So, good luck...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Seriously, what's with her?!
Not once did she say that she's sorry!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, she said that she was here just to say bye to us, but she really showed us her teeth there.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, she came here because she wanted to trash-talk us? Honestly, that girl...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Arisa's a very hard-working girl who doesn't go easy on others or herself...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Which is why she hardly ever tells anyone “good luck” or “try harder” like she just did...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Does that mean she's sort of acknowledging me as an idol...?)
A few weeks later
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That episode of idol Hazard, a.k.a. iHaz, finally aired last night...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And everybody's going nuts about us!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah, they are.
A lot of my classmates were also talking about it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're getting a ton of emails and DMs too! They're all people saying how they saw us on TV and what they thought.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: They're almost all saying positive things about us. You in particular definitely seem to have a lot more fans now, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I do?!
That's wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They must've been so moved by your story!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It also gave a lot of people an opportunity to learn about MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We were ultimately shown in a positive light. As worried as I was about this initially, I'm glad we accepted this offer.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which means our first appearance on TV as MORE MORE JUMP! was a resounding success!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And since we're getting such a positive response, we might be asked to make another appearance.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: At the same time, this is only our first step. We can't lose sight of our goal... Let's keep doing everything we can to make our show at the Dome a reality!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (When I was still in Cheerful * Days, I only said what was written in the scripts I was given...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But now, I can use my own words to spread hope to our fans.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Which is strange because I wouldn't have been able to not too long ago...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They must've been so moved by your story!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I'm not scared anymore. So...)

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: So, good luck...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I'm going to be myself and spread as much hope as I can with this group.)
